# BookWeave EPUB fixtures — ground truth

Five small, genuinely valid EPUBs for the BookWeave plugin (browser EPUB
reader + 《》 book-title extractor), plus the machine-readable contract
[`expected.json`](expected.json).

Everything here was generated by [`build_fixtures.py`](build_fixtures.py)
(Python 3.9 stdlib `zipfile` only, no `lxml`/`ebooklib`) and is re-validated by
[`verify_fixtures.py`](verify_fixtures.py), which exits non-zero on any
mismatch. Rebuild + re-verify with:

```sh
python3 build_fixtures.py     # deterministic: fixed zip timestamps
python3 verify_fixtures.py    # zip integrity, mimetype, minidom, counts
```

## 1. The contract: `expected.json`

A **flat object keyed by archive filename** (`zh-basic.epub`, …). Each value
has **exactly four keys** — no extra metadata, so strict deep-equal passes:

| key | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `chapters` | number of chapter documents in reading order (spine `itemref` count) |
| `title` | OPF `dc:title`, verbatim |
| `author` | OPF `dc:creator`, verbatim |
| `expectedBooks` | `{exact 《》 title: occurrence count}` over the body text of the chapter documents, **after the documented exclusions** |

Key insertion order is irrelevant to a deep-equal comparison.

### Important: `文心雕龙` is expected at 1, not excluded

`文心雕龙` is a real book title written with `《》` in chapter 4 of
`zh-basic.epub`, so the harness **must** assert `expectedBooks["文心雕龙"] === 1`.
Only the two marks in the next section are excluded. The neighbouring `〈原道〉`
uses single angle brackets (`〈` U+3008 / `〉` U+3009) and therefore **never**
matches the `《([^《》]+)》` pattern — that is the behaviour being tested.

## 3. `zh-basic.epub` (EPUB 3)

Structure: `mimetype`, `META-INF/container.xml` → `OEBPS/content.opf`,
`OEBPS/nav.xhtml` (EPUB 3 nav, `properties="nav"`), `OEBPS/toc.ncx` (EPUB 2
compatibility), `OEBPS/styles/style.css`, `OEBPS/text/chapter1..5.xhtml`.
`nav.xhtml` is in the manifest **but not in the spine**, so
`chapters == 5` whether you count spine `itemref`s or chapter documents.
Metadata includes the EPUB 3 `dcterms:modified` meta.

Marks by chapter (verified from the built archive, not from intent):

| chapter file | heading | `《》` marks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OEBPS/text/chapter1.xhtml` | 第一章 旧书架 | 红楼梦 ×2, 人类简史 ×1 |
| `OEBPS/text/chapter2.xhtml` | 第二章 灯下对读 | 红楼梦 ×1, 百年孤独 ×1, 人民日报 ×1 |
| `OEBPS/text/chapter3.xhtml` | 第三章 读书会 | 百年孤独 ×1, 人类简史 ×1, 测试之书 ×1 |
| `OEBPS/text/chapter4.xhtml` | 第四章 注疏与闲读 | 文心雕龙 ×1, 活着 ×1, `〈原道〉` (not a match) |
| `OEBPS/text/chapter5.xhtml` | 第五章 自述 | 人民日报 ×1 |

Totals: 红楼梦 3, 百年孤独 2, 人类简史 2, 活着 1, 文心雕龙 1, 人民日报 2,
测试之书 1 → 12 marks; after exclusions 9 occurrences / 5 titles.

Paragraph-level invariants (asserted by the builder, required by the extractor
harness):

* **Exactly one** paragraph mentions 红楼梦 *and* 百年孤独 — chapter 2,
  paragraph 1 ("…一边是《红楼梦》，一边是《百年孤独》…"). Co-occurrence edge
  weight must be **1**, not 2.
* **Exactly one** (different) paragraph mentions 红楼梦 twice — chapter 1,
  paragraph 2. No other paragraph repeats a title.
* The `〈原道〉` sentence is chapter 4, paragraph 1:
  "案头那本《文心雕龙》里的〈原道〉篇，他前后抄过三遍…".
* No `《》` mark appears in the OPF, NCX or nav, so a reader that naively
  concatenates every XML text node still sees the same counts.

## 4. `gbk-encoded.epub` (EPUB 2, GBK content)

`META-INF/container.xml` → `OEBPS/content.opf` (UTF-8), `OEBPS/toc.ncx`, two
chapter documents at `OEBPS/text/chapter1.xhtml` / `chapter2.xhtml`. The two
content documents are **GBK bytes** on disk: XML declaration
`encoding="gbk"`, `<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=gbk"/>`,
no BOM. OPF/NCX stay UTF-8 (a valid EPUB 2 mix; decoding is driven by each
document's declaration / `meta`).

| chapter file | heading | `《》` marks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OEBPS/text/chapter1.xhtml` | 第一章 灯下读经 | 论语 ×1, 道德经 ×1 |
| `OEBPS/text/chapter2.xhtml` | 第二章 抄书 | 论语 ×1 |

Note for the Node harness: do not detect encoding by "try UTF-8, fall back on
error" — some GBK byte pairs (e.g. `0xC4 0xB8`) are also valid UTF-8 sequences,
so a trial decode can succeed with mojibake. Use the XML declaration / `meta
charset` value. (Python's `pyexpat` cannot parse GBK byte streams at all, which
is why `verify_fixtures.py` decodes first and then parses.)

## 5. `no-toc.epub` (EPUB 2, spine only)

Manifest holds only the two chapter documents; there is **no** `nav.xhtml`,
**no** `toc.ncx`, and the `spine` element has **no** `toc` attribute. Chapter
headings are plain `<h1>` ("第一章 开篇", "第二章 夜读").
Marks: `史记` ×1 in each of the two chapters → total 2.

## 6. `stored-entries.epub` (EPUB 2, all entries stored)

`toc.ncx` present, two chapters. Every entry — including the payload, not just
`mimetype` — has ZIP compression method **0** (stored), which exercises readers
that mishandle uncompressed entries. Marks: `围城` ×1 per chapter → total 2.

## 7. `percent-href.epub` (nested OPF, `%20` hrefs, 3 chapters)

`META-INF/container.xml` points at `OEBPS/content/book.opf` (note the extra
`content/` directory level). Manifest/NCX hrefs are percent-encoded:
`chapter%201.xhtml` resolves to the archive entry `OEBPS/content/chapter 1.xhtml`
(real space in the filename). `toc.ncx` sits next to the OPF, so its `content
src` values are percent-encoded too.

| chapter file | heading | `《》` marks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OEBPS/content/chapter 1.xhtml` | 第一章 车上 | 边城 ×1 |
| `OEBPS/content/chapter 2.xhtml` | 第二章 雨天 | (no marks — edge case) |
| `OEBPS/content/chapter 3.xhtml` | 第三章 多年以后 | 边城 ×1 |

`chapters` is 3; the middle chapter deliberately mentions no book.

## 8. Exclusions (subtracted from the counts above)

| mark | fixture | source count | why excluded |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| `人民日报` | `zh-basic.epub` | 2 | periodical / newspaper, not a book title |
| `测试之书` | `zh-basic.epub` | 1 | self-reference: it is the fixture's own `dc:title` |
| `〈原道〉` | `zh-basic.epub` | 0 | uses single angle brackets `〈〉`; it is a chapter of 《文心雕龙》, not a `《》` title. The extractor must return 0 for it — but must return 1 for its parent book `文心雕龙`. |

The excluded marks are still present in the source text (verified by
`verify_fixtures.py`), so an extractor that reports them will fail the contract
rather than silently pass.

parses with `xml.dom.minidom`; `mimetype` is the first entry, stored, with no
extra field, containing exactly `application/epub+zip`; all manifest / NCX /
nav hrefs resolve after percent-decoding; every relative `href`/`src` inside the
chapter XHTML (including the shared stylesheet) resolves to an archive entry;
the bytes re-read from each archive are byte-identical to the builder's intent;
and each archive matches `expected.json` exactly.

### 9b. Pre-zip check inside the builder

Before zipping, `build_fixtures.py` asserts that the generated XHTML contains
exactly the planned marks, and prints the plan (this is the "grep before
zipping" step, done on the in-memory documents):

```
    zh-basic paragraph shapes: co-occurrence(红楼梦+百年孤独)=1, double-红楼梦 paragraph=1
  zh-basic.epub
    pre-zip marks: 人民日报=2, 人类简史=2, 文心雕龙=1, 活着=1, 测试之书=1, 百年孤独=2, 红楼梦=3
  gbk-encoded.epub
    pre-zip marks: 论语=2, 道德经=1
  no-toc.epub
    pre-zip marks: 史记=2
  stored-entries.epub
    pre-zip marks: 围城=2
  percent-href.epub
    pre-zip marks: 边城=2
```

Extracting each archive with `python3 -m zipfile -e` and grepping the raw
XHTML with `grep -oh '《[^》]*》' | sort | uniq -c`:

```
=== zh-basic (all chapter XHTML) ===
   3 《红楼梦》
   2 《百年孤独》
   2 《人类简史》
   2 《人民日报》
   1 《测试之书》
   1 《活着》
   1 《文心雕龙》
=== gbk-encoded (iconv -f gbk -t utf-8 first) ===
chapter1: 《论语》 《道德经》
chapter2: 《论语》
=== no-toc / stored-entries / percent-href ===
   2 《史记》
   2 《围城》
   2 《边城》
```

## 10. Decisions taken (and remaining ambiguities)

1. **`文心雕龙` is counted (1).** Task-1's fixture text requires the
   《文心雕龙》 sentence; since `文心雕龙` is itself a `《》`-marked title it is
   included in `expectedBooks` (confirmed with the Lead). The alternative
   reading — dropping the `《文心雕龙》` mention so only `〈原道〉` appears — was
   rejected.
2. **Unspecified values** (task-1 pinned only `zh-basic`): chapter counts and
   titles were chosen and documented above —
   `gbk-encoded` 2ch 《国学札记》, `no-toc` 2ch 《读史札记》,
   `stored-entries` 2ch 《书斋随笔》, `percent-href` 3ch 《行旅小记》;
   `author` is `测试作者` everywhere. No fixture title is written with `《》`
   in its own prose except the single deliberate self-reference in
   `zh-basic` (`《测试之书》` ×1).
3. **`expected.json` keying** is by archive filename, values have exactly
   `{chapters, title, author, expectedBooks}`. If the harness wants different
   keys, only this file (and the `expected_all` lookup in the verifier) needs
   to change — the archives are unaffected.
4. **`chapters`** is the spine `itemref` count, which equals the number of
   chapter documents in every fixture (the `zh-basic` nav document is
   manifest-only, not in the spine).
5. **Structural documents contain no `《》` marks** by design, so per-chapter
   vs. whole-document counting cannot diverge for these fixtures.
6. Fixture files are byte-stable across rebuilds (fixed ZIP timestamps and
   permission bits), so the SHA-256 values above are reproducible.
